subject: Startups
title: What Is Product-Led Growth?
description: A micro-lesson that makes What Is Product-Led Growth? usable.

hook.text: Slack didn't have a sales team for years. The product sold itself. Users tried it, loved it, and told their bosses.

buildup.text: Product-led growth means the product is the main driver of acquisition, activation, and expansion.

discovery.text: Free tiers let users experience value before paying. When value is obvious, the upgrade sells itself.

twist.text: Sales-led companies spend 40-50% of revenue on sales. Product-led companies spend 20% and grow faster.

climax.text: Zoom, Notion, Figma, and Calendly all grew this way. The product replaced the salesperson.

punchline.text: If the product needs a salesperson, the product isn't done.

quiz.question: What is the core idea of product-led growth?
options: The product itself drives user acquisition
